# Mozilla PDF.js 5.6.205

Unmodified minified browser module and worker copied from the bundled pdfjs-dist 5.6.205 package. Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js . License: Apache-2.0, retained in LICENSE and module headers. These assets are hosted locally; no CDN or third-party service is contacted to render the guide. The viewer loads only the fixed local Ham-Rx PDF. It does not accept arbitrary URLs or access radio data.
